data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 defines genuine reliability as invariance under perturbations that change the cue-answer mapping, but this diagnostic cannot be executed 'within a single evaluation' as the problem requires. Distribution-shift stress-testing requires at least two evaluations (training distribution + shifted distribution) to compare invariance. By locating its distinguishing evidence outside the single evaluation, SRC_002 fails to identify evidence available within the constrained scope the problem specifies.
